content.value: Draw the block diagram of offset QPSK (OQPSK) and hence explain the bandwidth considerations of it.

'd) For a BPSK modulator with a carrier frequency of 70 MHz and an input bit rate of 10 Mbps, determine the maximum and minimum upper and lower side frequencies, the minimum Nyquist bandwidth and the baud rate. Also draw its output spectrum.
